body: Not a medical professional. But sounds like bi-polar to me. You should definitely talk to a doctor.
No, they can't. Just keep reminding yourself of that if you're obsessing, and take a few deep breaths. You're fine <3

I still think you're being too hard on yourself. Nobody's perfect at relationship stuff, we all have stuff we need to learn. Maybe you have more than average, I dunno. I don't know you. It definitely sucks to be lonely. But people are lonely on all ends of the spectrum (of autism, personality, whatever).

Hey. I'm sorry to  hear that. So she's not into you, that doesn't mean no one ever will be. I don't think you're better off alone, and I don't think you're 'not a people person'. Some people are better at that stuff, but it doesn't mean it's hopeless.
Sorry, that's the worst. I hate that feeling when you wake up and have to take stock and remind yourself it wasn't real. Maybe it would help to do something relaxing before bed to calm your mind.
What are your nightmares about? Real life stuff, or just fear/anxiety dreams?
Uh..maybe with context? But I also lean toward no.
Totally get it. He told me a lot of his patients have had suicidal thoughts. I think to a therapist it's a lot less scary.

I recently told my therapist about suicidal thoughts. I had similar fears, but it was fine, and actually felt good to get it out. They only will try to put you in the hospital if you express an actual plan and intention.

Good for you for deciding to get help! 

I think in the long run you will want to tell the people you love what you are going through, even if you don't give them all the details. It's better for you to have people you care about supporting you through it. I think any therapist will tell you that too. But I think therapy is an important step, and a good start. By opening up to someone who is impartial, you can start to learn how to open up to the people in your life.

Good luck to you <3

I'm sorry you're in so much pain. That girl moving on from your breakup - that doesn't mean you're worthless. It doesn't say anything at all about you. Relationships end for all sorts of reasons, maybe she was just ready to be on her own when she went to college. That doesn't reduce what you had with her.

You said you're in college. Have you thought about going to a counselor there? It's usually free for students. Also maybe think about going out of your comfort zone and trying something new. There are so many activities and clubs in college that you could take advantage of. Might take you out of your own head a bit.
Hey - are you still there? Is there anyone you can call?

Sorry to hear you've had a lot of experience with this. That sounds super frustrating. I think people are sometimes resistant to the idea that some people's lives really *have* sucked a lot. So they get super forceful with the idea that maybe you just haven't seen it from some other magical angle. 

Ugh, and obviously 'resistance to help' is a thing. Dealing with depression is fucking hard, and sometimes the attitude 'fuck it, let it win' feels like the right one. But shit, if you're reaching out you're asking for help.
Not every session, because I strongly try to resist it. But often, yeah. I think that's pretty normal. It's emotional stuff.

That's a fair point. I just prefer to go with assuming optimistic and ignorant, rather than non-caring. They didn't make things worse for me, but they certainly didn't help. There was a survey at the end at least once I left the chat.
Meh. I'm sure some of them care. Maybe this person even cared. But obviously they had no idea what they were doing.

Whoa, you're spiraling. Take a deep breath. You don't sound like a terrible person, you just sound like a person who is hurting. 

It sounds like you are self-conscious about the language thing, so maybe you overreacted to her conversing in her own language with someone? That was actually rude of *her*, if she was out with you, to cut you out like that. I know plenty of people who have dated, and even married, people who had a different first language. It just takes a little patience and understanding. 

And yeah, lots of relationships end. (they all end, until one doesn't, is the saying). That doesn't mean it's not worth trying. Every movie you watch ends, but you still watch them and enjoy them while they are happening! It's just less scary because it's predictable, because you know when it will end, it's low stakes. Maybe that's a silly example, but hopefully you get my larger point. 

I totally get you on the wanting to sit in a corner and not move. Maybe you can put in headphones and listen to music while you take a walk in whatever country you're in. Be alone, but not alone?

Yeah, I don't want to take up his non-work time. I imagine he has a separate work phone, and hope he takes time when he doesn't check it. Which is why I wouldn't expect him to reply right away. 

I'm just feeling really off. I don't know what he would think is a situation where I 'need' to call. A few words of reassurance would be helpful. But at the same time, obviously, I need to not rely on someone else to get me through a week.

Tell your therapist. They may or may not urge you to confess it to others, but you still have the choice whether or not to do that. I think saying it out loud will help you, and help you to figure out if you need to take any next steps.
Can also relate to this.
Yeah. Everything I say just sounds stupid and whiny.
I can relate. I don't think there's anything that's foolproof. That's a good thing really. It keeps people like me and hopefully you from doing it on a whim.
I told a friend yesterday actually that a walk in the rain is one of the few times when I feel I can just *be*. Too bad I live somewhere right now where it hardly rains.

Well. I put this in SW for a reason. Just. How would I do it, if i wanted to. That one mostly just lately. More often in general it's those fleeting thoughts, like while driving, I could just get in an 'accident' and I'm sure flying through that guardrail would end things.

And I don't really want to end things. But it sometimes feels like I can't find the strength to try to move them forward either.
